label: 清冷妩媚钓系大头照：狐狸眼、莓果唇、低照度灰粉调

subject.description: a young adult East Asian woman with long black hair, a few soft loose strands resting naturally across her forehead and the sides of her face,
subject.pose: facing the camera directly with a cool, sultry, languid, restrained allure — the quiet confidence of someone who knows she is beautiful, beautiful but never showy — her face from forehead to chin filling the entire frame, cheeks almost touching the frame edges
subject.expression: her half-lidded eyes gazing lazily straight into the lens with slightly lifted outer corners and a subtle fox-eye allure — never an exaggerated seductive smile, never a sweet-girl look
subject.wardrobe: an understated dark-toned top that stays out of the frame's focus

sections.heading: Features
sections.body: a smooth, refined narrow oval face with a small delicate chin, a slim straight nose with a refined tip, and compact well-centered features that keep a soft, delicate East Asian femininity.

sections.heading: Eye makeup
sections.body: low-saturation powdery gray, grayish violet-pink-brown eyeshadow with a faint lotus-pink wash under the eyes and fine natural aegyo-sal; a thin precise eyeliner extending naturally from the lash roots, visibly elongated and upturned at the outer corners to sculpt a long fox-eye contour; long, clearly separated lashes with a focused, lucid gaze.

sections.heading: Lip makeup
sections.body: deep rose, berry-rose, cool-toned berry lips — full and refined with a defined cupid's bow, a soft satin sheen, the corners lifted almost imperceptibly; no teeth, no big laugh, the expression restrained yet sultry.

sections.heading: Skin
sections.body: a cool-toned soft-focus base, translucent and fine, keeping slight real skin texture.

camera.position: at extremely close range, the features pressed strongly toward the lens
camera.perspective: shallow depth of field, soft focus
camera.framing: the face as the absolute visual center, a frontal straight-on view, the frame nearly filled by the face alone

light.key: Soft low-intensity studio light, frontal and slightly to the side, with delicate shadows and a soft-focus cinematic feel on the face

background: deeply blurred with all detail suppressed, so only the face, the eyes, the lip color, and a few black loose strands stand out
palette_text: cold gray, powdery gray-pink, lotus pink, berry red
atmosphere: a moody, low-key, cold-sultry luxury beauty-editorial mood
